ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts: Press the keys you want; Esc cancels.
Shortcuts for the panel rail. Focus a field and press the keys you want; Esc cancels, Reset restores an action's default, and Clear leaves it unbound.

The browser's own shortcuts answer only while the browser pane or a page inside it has focus: new tab, reopen tab, the address bar and switching tabs. That is deliberate, because the app must not take those chords away from the rest of the interface. To use one, focus the browser first.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.browser_a: Reserved: focuses the browser address bar. Focus the browser first.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.browser_b: Reserved: goes back in the browser, or between chats outside it.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.browser_f: Reserved: goes forward in the browser, or between chats outside it.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.browser_l: Reserved: switches to the last browser tab. Focus the browser first.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.browser_n: Reserved: opens a new browser tab. Focus the browser first.
Reserved: switches to browser tab {digit, number, ::group-off}. Focus the browser first.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.browser_r: Reserved: reloads the browser page, or the app window outside it.
Reserved: reloads the browser page without its cache, or the app window outside it.
Reserved: reopens the last closed browser tab. Focus the browser first.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.canvas_op: Reserved: opens a file in the canvas.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.chat_move: Reserved: moves the focused chat down the pinned order.
Reserved: moves the focused chat up the pinned order.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.chat_regi: Reserved: walks down the chat regions.
Reserved: walks up the chat regions.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.chat_tags: Reserved: opens the focused conversation's tags.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.close: Reserved: closes the browser tab, or the window outside it.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.find: Reserved: finds in the browser page, or searches the transcript outside it.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.palette_a: Reserved: opens the command palette from anywhere.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.palette_c: Reserved: opens the command palette on chats.
Reserved: opens the command palette on commands.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.redo_wind: Reserved: redo on Windows and Linux.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.zoom_in: Reserved: zooms the browser page or app in.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.zoom_out: Reserved: zooms the browser page or app out.
ui.settings.shortcuts.reserved.zoom_rese: Reserved: resets browser page zoom, or app zoom outside it.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts: Focus a shortcut field and press keys to save immediately. Esc clears the capture cue; Reset restores the default.
